title: Fairness Across the World
title_zh: 全球公平性研究
title_primary: 全球公平性研究
title_secondary: Fairness Across the World
authors: Ingvild Almås, Alexander W Cappelen, Erik Ø Sørensen, Bertil Tungodden
official: 官方在线 2026-09-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper provides the first comprehensive global evidence on people’s fairness and efficiency preferences, beliefs about the sources of inequality and the efficiency cost of redistribution, and policy attitudes toward redistribution. Using a globally harmonized consequential experiment with more than 65,000 individuals across 60 countries, we show that the source of inequality plays a substantially larger role for inequality acceptance than the efficiency cost of redistribution. At the global level, implemented inequality increases by 85 percent when inequality is caused by merit rather than luck, compared to a 14 percent increase when redistribution entails a 50 percent efficiency cost. We document substantial heterogeneity in fairness views and beliefs both within and across societies. The meritocratic fairness view is most prominent in many richer Western societies, while libertarian and egalitarian fairness views are widespread in many other parts of the world. Globally, people are more likely to believe that inequality reflects luck rather than merit, while beliefs in large efficiency costs of redistribution are relatively weak. Fairness preferences and beliefs are strongly associated with redistribution attitudes and actual redistribution through taxes and transfers across countries. Our findings illustrate how the interaction between fairness views and beliefs may shape redistribution across societies, highlighting the importance of jointly understanding preferences and beliefs in the political economy of redistribution.
abstract_zh: 本文提供了关于人们公平与效率偏好、对不平等根源及再分配效率成本的信念，以及对再分配政策态度的首份全球性综合证据。通过一项涵盖60个国家、超过65,000名参与者的全球统一后果实验，我们表明，不平等的根源在不平等接受度中所起的作用远大于再分配的效率成本。在全球层面，当不平等源于才能而非运气时，实际不平等程度增加了85%，相比之下，当再分配涉及50%的效率成本时，仅增加了14%。我们记录了公平观念和信念在各类社会内部及跨社会间的显著异质性。精英主义的公平观在许多较富裕的西方社会中最为突出，而自由主义和平均主义的公平观在世界其他许多地区广泛存在。全球范围内，人们更倾向于认为不平等反映的是运气而非才能，而对再分配存在高额效率成本的信念相对较弱。公平偏好和信念与再分配态度及各国通过税收和转移支付实现的实际再分配密切相关。我们的发现揭示了公平观念与信念之间的相互作用如何可能塑造各社会的再分配格局，强调了在再分配的政治经济学中共同理解偏好与信念的重要性。

title: Flow
title_zh: 资本流动
title_primary: 资本流动
title_secondary: Flow
authors: Caitlin Dannhauser, Jeffrey Pontiff
official: 官方在线 2026-09-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Performance chasing is pervasive in active mutual funds, index mutual funds, and ETFs, with positive flow-performance sensitivity evident in both broad-based and niche funds and for the skill and nonskill components of returns. The sensitivity of ETFs is greatest, with insignificant differences between active and index mutual funds. The heightened sensitivity of ETFs is not explained by benchmark design or exchange trading, and is amplified by institutional ownership. Institutional trading of ETFs follows a momentum strategy, rather than flow management or benchmarking. Institutional herding and the outsourcing of investment management to model portfolios heightens the performance sensitivity of ETF flows. (JEL G10, G11, G23)
abstract_zh: 业绩追逐在主动型共同基金、指数共同基金及交易所交易基金（ETF）中普遍存在，正向的资金-业绩敏感性在广泛型和细分型基金中均有体现，且对收益的技能与非技能组成部分均显著。ETF的敏感性最高，而主动型与指数共同基金之间的差异不显著。ETF敏感性增强并非由基准设计或交易所交易机制所解释，且机构持股会放大这一效应。机构对ETF的交易遵循动量策略，而非资金管理或基准跟踪策略。机构羊群行为及将投资管理外包至模型组合的做法，进一步加剧了ETF资金流的业绩敏感性。（JEL G10, G11, G23）

title: Dominant Currencies: How firms choose currency invoicing and why it matters
title_zh: 主导货币：企业如何选择计价货币及其重要性
title_primary: 主导货币：企业如何选择计价货币及其重要性
title_secondary: Dominant Currencies: How firms choose currency invoicing and why it matters
authors: Mary Amiti, Oleg Itskhoki, Jozef Konings
official: 官方在线 2020-10-05 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The currency of invoicing in international trade is central for the international transmission of shocks and macroeconomic policies. Using a new dataset on currency invoicing for Belgian firms, we analyze how firms make their currency choice, for both exports and imports, and the implications of this choice for exchange rate pass-through into prices and quantities. We derive our estimating equations from a theoretical framework that features variable markups, international input sourcing, and staggered price setting with endogenous currency choice, and also allowing for the dominant currency choice. Our structural specification provides a new test of the allocative consequences of nominal rigidities, by estimating the treatment effect of foreign-currency price stickiness on the dynamic response of prices and quantities to exchange rate changes, controlling for the endogeneity of the firm's currency choice. We show that flexible-price determinants of exchange rate pass-through are also the key firm characteristics that determine currency choice. In particular, small non-importing firms tend to price their exports in euros (producer currency) and exhibit close to complete exchange-rate pass-through into destination prices at all horizons. In contrast, large import-intensive firms tend to denominate their exports in foreign currencies, and especially in the US dollar, exhibiting a lower pass-through of the euro-destination exchange rate and a pronounced sensitivity to the dollar-destination exchangerate. Finally, the effects of foreign-currency price stickiness are still significant beyond the one-year horizon, but gradually dissipate in the long run, consistent with sticky price models of currency choice.
abstract_zh: 国际贸易中的计价货币选择对于冲击的国际传导和宏观经济政策至关重要。利用比利时企业计价货币的新数据集，我们分析了企业如何在出口和进口中做出货币选择，以及这一选择对汇率传递至价格和数量的影响。我们从包含可变加成、国际投入采购以及具有内生货币选择的分阶段定价的理论框架中推导出估计方程，并允许主导货币选择。我们的结构规范通过估计外币价格粘性对价格和数量对汇率变化动态响应的处理效应，为名义刚性的配置后果提供了新的检验，同时控制了企业货币选择的内生性。我们表明，汇率传递的弹性价格决定因素也是决定货币选择的关键企业特征。特别是，小型非进口企业倾向于以欧元（生产者货币）计价其出口，并在所有时间范围内表现出对目的地价格几乎完全的汇率传递。相比之下，大型进口密集型企业倾向于以外币，尤其是美元计价其出口，表现出对欧元-目的地汇率较低的传递性，并对美元-目的地汇率具有显著敏感性。最后，外币价格粘性的影响在一年期之后仍然显著，但在长期内逐渐消散，这与货币选择的粘性价格模型一致。

title: Crisis, credit risk, and productivity: lessons from the Vietnamese banking sector during COVID-19
title_zh: 危机、信用风险与生产率：COVID-19期间越南银行业的经验教训
title_primary: 危机、信用风险与生产率：COVID-19期间越南银行业的经验教训
title_secondary: Crisis, credit risk, and productivity: lessons from the Vietnamese banking sector during COVID-19
authors: Van Nguyen, Phuong Thanh Le, Reza Kiani Mavi, Amir Arjomandi
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study investigates how an unprecedented systemic shock, the COVID-19 pandemic, reshaped bank productivity and intermediation efficiency in Vietnam, one of the fastest-growing emerging economies. We develop a novel risk-adjusted total factor productivity (TFP) measure based on the by-production Luenberger–Hicks–Moorsteen (LHM) indicator, which incorporates non-performing loans as undesirable outputs to better capture credit-risk dynamics. Using a balanced panel covering both the pre-pandemic and pandemic periods (2016–2022), our results show that Vietnamese banks experienced a general decline in productivity before and during COVID-19, driven largely by reductions in technical and scale efficiency. However, foreign and state-owned banks recorded stronger technological progress during the pandemic, reflecting accelerated digital transformation and operational adjustment. Regression results reveal a positive relationship between the COVID-19 period and productivity, suggesting that crisis-driven innovation and policy intervention helped offset negative shocks. Conversely, credit growth, loan-loss provisioning, bank size, and deposit dependence are all negatively associated with productivity, underscoring the importance of prudent risk management, optimal scale, and funding diversification for sustaining performance under stress.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了前所未有的系统性冲击——新冠疫情，如何重塑越南（增长最快的新兴经济体之一）的银行生产率和中介效率。我们基于副产品卢恩伯格-希克斯-穆尔斯滕（LHM）指标，开发了一种新颖的风险调整后全要素生产率（TFP）衡量方法，该方法将不良贷款作为非期望产出纳入考量，以更准确地捕捉信用风险动态。利用涵盖疫情前和疫情期间（2016-2022年）的平衡面板数据，我们的结果显示，越南银行在疫情前及疫情期间普遍经历生产率下降，这主要归因于技术效率和规模效率的降低。然而，外资银行和国有银行在疫情期间录得了更强的技术进步，反映出数字化转型加速和运营调整。回归结果显示，疫情期间与生产率之间存在正相关关系，表明危机驱动的创新和政策干预有助于抵消负面冲击。相反，信贷增长、贷款损失拨备、银行规模和存款依赖度均与生产率负相关，这强调了审慎风险管理、最优规模和资金来源多元化对于在压力下维持绩效的重要性。

title: Dynamic Complementarity
title_zh: 动态互补性
title_primary: 动态互补性
title_secondary: Dynamic Complementarity
authors: Heckman, James, Tian, Haihan, Zhang, Zijian, Zhou, Jin
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Applied Economics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: Dynamic complementarity is the concept that past investments that lead to higher stocks of skill at one age promote the growth of skills from investment at that age. We define and provide evidence on dynamic complementarity using unique Chinese data from a home visiting program for young children targeted to parents in rural China. In addition, we investigate growth in learning due to innate, parental, and environmental factors that occur in the absence of any formal intervention.
abstract_zh: 动态互补性是指过去投资导致某一年龄段技能存量增加，进而促进该年龄段投资所带来技能增长的概念。我们利用中国农村地区针对幼儿家长的家访项目的独特数据，定义并提供了动态互补性的证据。此外，我们还考察了在没有正式干预的情况下，由先天、父母及环境因素引起的学习增长情况。

title: Tracing the Impact of Payment Convenience on Deposits: Evidence from Depositor Activeness
title_zh: 支付便利性对存款的影响追踪：来自存款人活跃度的证据
title_primary: 支付便利性对存款的影响追踪：来自存款人活跃度的证据
title_secondary: Tracing the Impact of Payment Convenience on Deposits: Evidence from Depositor Activeness
authors: Xu Lu, Yang Song, Yao Zeng
official: 官方在线 2026-08-24 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: How slow are bank transfers, and how do transfer delays affect deposit demand? Using transaction-level data from millions of depositors, we measure transfer delays by matching debits and credits across accounts held by the same depositor. Shorter delays correlate with more transfers and lower balances. Exploiting county-level exposure to Zelle’s staggered rollout, we find that faster payments reduce delays and deposit growth. Calibrating a deposit-management model, we find that transfer delays raise deposit demand, and the magnitude of this effect varies with interest rates and consumption volatility. Payment frictions therefore shape transactional deposit demand and monetary transmission.
abstract_zh: 银行转账有多慢，转账延迟又如何影响存款需求？利用数百万储户的交易级数据，我们通过匹配同一储户账户间的借方与贷方来度量转账延迟。较短的延迟与更多的转账次数和更低的账户余额相关联。利用县级对Zelle分阶段推出的暴露度，我们发现更快的支付减少了延迟并降低了存款增长。校准一个存款管理模型后，我们发现转账延迟提高了存款需求，且这一效应的大小随利率和消费波动性而变化。因此，支付摩擦塑造了交易性存款需求和货币传导机制。

title: Reconstructing a Century of U.S. Corporate Bonds: Credit Risk in Historical Perspective
title_zh: 重构美国公司债百年史：历史视角下的信用风险
title_primary: 重构美国公司债百年史：历史视角下的信用风险
title_secondary: Reconstructing a Century of U.S. Corporate Bonds: Credit Risk in Historical Perspective
authors: Mohammad Ghaderi, Sébastien Plante, Nikolai Roussanov, Sang Byung Seo
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Do corporate bond investors earn compensation for bearing credit risk? We construct a new historical corporate bond database spanning 128 years to estimate a corporate bond counterpart to the equity risk premium. Combining hand-collected archival data with modern sources, we assemble a panel of over 100,000 bonds and 7 million observations. While recent samples suggest corporate bond excess returns largely reflect the term premium, our long sample reveals a sizable and statistically significant credit risk premium. Credit spreads predict future corporate bond returns and macroeconomic aggregates, though their ability to forecast business cycle fluctuations weakens when prewar data are included.
abstract_zh: 企业债券投资者是否因承担信用风险而获得补偿？我们构建了一个跨越128年的全新历史企业债券数据库，用以估算与股票风险溢价相对应的企业债券风险溢价。通过将手工收集的档案数据与现代数据源相结合，我们汇集了一个包含超过10万只债券、700万条观测值的面板数据集。尽管近期样本显示企业债券超额收益主要反映期限溢价，但我们的长期样本揭示了一个规模可观且统计显著的信用风险溢价。信用利差能够预测未来企业债券回报及宏观经济总量，尽管在纳入战前数据后，其预测商业周期波动的能力有所减弱。

title: Comparing carrots and sticks to create a more circular food system
title_zh: 比较胡萝卜与大棒政策以构建更循环的食品体系
title_primary: 比较胡萝卜与大棒政策以构建更循环的食品体系
title_secondary: Comparing carrots and sticks to create a more circular food system
authors: Junyoung Jeong, Yongyang Cai, Brian E. Roe
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Circular economy solutions within the food system have prioritized prevention. Prevention policies can be formulated as carrots, e.g., waste abatement subsidies, or sticks, e.g., waste disposal taxes, and applied at one or more segments along the food supply chain. We develop a general equilibrium model of the U.S. Midwest that endogenizes food waste decisions and policy responses at key supply chain links. Existing models of circular food systems often fail to endogenize the amount of food waste and seldom apply multiple policies at different food supply chain stages. Our results identify how carrots and sticks differ across targeted supply chain stages. Waste abatement subsidies primarily result in a decrease in waste rates, while a food waste tax leads consumers to adjust both food purchases and waste rates equally. Subsidizing waste abatement can be five times more effective than a food waste tax in reducing food waste, despite both yielding comparable emissions reductions. 88% of emissions reduction caused by a tax derives from reduced food demand (and thus supply). With abatement subsidies, 28% of emissions reduction derives from decreased landfill deposits and 64% from reduced food supply. Our results also suggest that policies aimed at consumers can have four times greater impacts than those applied upstream. Lastly, as their combinations typically generate additive effects, carrots and sticks can complement one another, further informing an optimal policy suite that reduces food waste, while mitigating unintended consequences (e.g., rebound effects or consumption reduction).
abstract_zh: 食品系统内的循环经济解决方案优先考虑了预防措施。预防政策可设计为激励手段，如废弃物减排补贴，或约束手段，如废弃物处理税，并可在食品供应链的一个或多个环节实施。我们构建了一个美国中西部地区的可计算一般均衡模型，该模型内生了关键供应链环节中的食物浪费决策及政策响应。现有的循环食品系统模型往往未能内生化食物浪费量，且很少在食品供应链的不同阶段同时应用多种政策。我们的研究结果揭示了激励与约束手段在不同目标供应链环节上的差异效应。废弃物减排补贴主要导致浪费率下降，而食物浪费税则促使消费者同时调整食品购买量和浪费率。在减少食物浪费方面，补贴废弃物减排的效果可能是食物浪费税的五倍，尽管两者在减排方面产生的效果相当。税收带来的排放减少中，88%源于食品需求（进而供应）的下降。而在补贴废弃物减排的情况下，排放减少的28%归因于垃圾填埋场沉积物的减少，64%则源于食品供应的缩减。我们的结果还表明，针对消费者的政策其影响可能是针对上游环节政策的四倍。最后，由于政策组合通常产生叠加效应，激励与约束手段可以相辅相成，为优化政策组合提供进一步指导，以在减少食物浪费的同时，缓解意外后果（如反弹效应或消费减少）。

title: Countercyclical Return Expectations: Evidence from the Livingston Survey
title_zh: 逆周期收益预期：来自利文斯顿调查的证据
title_primary: 逆周期收益预期：来自利文斯顿调查的证据
title_secondary: Countercyclical Return Expectations: Evidence from the Livingston Survey
authors: STIG V. MØLLER, THOMAS Q. PEDERSEN, SIGURD A. M. STEFFENSEN, MARTIN M. ANDREASEN
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2026-08-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper shows that forecasts from professional economists in the Livingston survey imply countercyclical variation in expected excess returns on U.S. stocks. These expectations are approximately rational and strongly positively correlated with expected excess returns from the log‐utility investor of Martin (2017), the habit model of Campbell and Cochrane (1999), and the long‐run risk model of Bansal and Yaron (2004). The Livingston survey also implies countercyclical cash flow expectations based on forecasts of tax‐adjusted corporate profits. However, this feature is not matched by either the habit or the long‐run risk model.
abstract_zh: 本文表明，利文斯顿调查中专业经济学家的预测暗示了美国股票预期超额收益的反周期变动。这些预期大致理性，并与马丁（2017）的对数效用投资者、坎贝尔和科克伦（1999）的习惯模型以及班萨尔和亚龙（2004）的长期风险模型所隐含的预期超额收益呈强烈正相关。利文斯顿调查还基于对税后企业利润的预测，暗示了现金流预期的反周期特征。然而，这一特征并未在习惯模型或长期风险模型中得到体现。

title: Reflections on Adoption of New Agricultural Practices
title_zh: 关于采纳新农业实践的思考
title_primary: 关于采纳新农业实践的思考
title_secondary: Reflections on Adoption of New Agricultural Practices
authors: David J. Pannell
official: 官方在线 2026-07-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Research on adoption of new practices, technologies and systems in agriculture has generated thousands of publications over the past 70 years, covering uptake of agricultural practices spanning more than 100 years. This paper contains selected key lessons from the results of this enormous research effort, drawn from numerous reviews of the literature and shaped by personal experience. The lessons include that trialling is not adoption, that extension is not necessarily the key to increasing adoption, that each new farming practice has its own adoption story, and that adoption is often slower than practice advocates expect, typically taking multiple decades. The identified lessons are juxtaposed with a number of flawed assumptions and misconceptions commonly held by people working in agricultural agencies. A number of methodological weaknesses are still common in existing studies, including neglect or poor representation of key variables, compromising the potential for the research to generate real understanding of adoption. This also inhibits comparison of studies and the application of meta‐analyses. Suggestions are made on ways to add value to the existing research and improve the quality of future research, including the collection and curation of good‐quality adoption data sets, the development of a searchable database of adoption studies, and the creation of best‐practice guidelines for the conduct of adoption research.
abstract_zh: 过去70年间，关于农业新实践、新技术和新系统采纳的研究已产出数千篇文献，涵盖跨越百余年的农业实践应用历程。本文从大量文献综述中提炼关键经验，并结合个人研究实践，呈现这项庞大研究工作的核心启示。这些经验包括：试验不等于采纳；技术推广并非提升采纳率的关键；每项新型农业实践都有其独特的采纳路径；采纳速度往往慢于实践倡导者的预期，通常需要数十年时间。本文将这些经验与农业机构从业者普遍存在的若干错误假设和认知误区进行对比分析。现有研究仍普遍存在方法论缺陷，包括关键变量的忽视或表征不足，这不仅削弱了研究对采纳机制的真实理解，也阻碍了跨研究比较与元分析的应用。本文提出提升现有研究价值、改进未来研究质量的建议，包括建立高质量采纳数据集并持续维护、开发可检索的采纳研究数据库，以及制定采纳研究最佳实践指南。

title: DP32 British Manufacturing Productivity 1955-1983: Measurement Problems, Oil Shocks and Thatcher Effects
title_zh: 英国制造业生产率 1955-1983：测量问题、石油冲击与撒切尔效应
title_primary: 英国制造业生产率 1955-1983：测量问题、石油冲击与撒切尔效应
title_secondary: DP32 British Manufacturing Productivity 1955-1983: Measurement Problems, Oil Shocks and Thatcher Effects
authors: John Muellbauer, Lionel Mendis, Guanyu Lu, Kenta Tanaka, Toshi H. Arimura 等
official: 官方在线 1984-11-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper throws light on these matters by means of an aggregate production function for British manufacturing estimated on quarterly data for 1956-83. This makes it possible to distinguish cyclical movements in productivity caused by variations in labour utilization from underlying trends. The measure of labour utilization rests on information on weekly hours of overtime work as a fraction of the normal work week. The paper also considers measurement problems in output for which several significant observable proxies are available and in capital, the latter being compared with the CBI's capacity utilization data and Bennett and Smith-Gavine's Percentage Utilization of Labour index. Estimates are provided of measurement biases in output and comparisons made between crude output per head and a productivity measure corrected for variations in utilization and measurement biases in output.
abstract_zh: 本文通过1956-1983年英国制造业季度数据估算的总量生产函数，揭示了相关问题。该函数能够区分由劳动利用率变化引起的生产率周期性波动与潜在趋势。劳动利用率的衡量基于每周加班工时占正常工时的比例。本文还探讨了产出（存在多个显著可观测代理变量）与资本（将其与英国工业联合会产能利用率数据、贝内特与史密斯-加文的劳动利用率百分比指数进行对比）的测量问题。研究提供了产出测量偏差的估计值，并对粗放式人均产出与经利用率变化及产出测量偏差校正后的生产率指标进行了比较。

authors: Jane Rapson, Samuel Bowles, Wendy Carlin, Sahana Subramanyam, Ambrogio Cesa-Bianchi 等

abstract: This paper provides a general review of recent developments in the application of control theory to macroeconomic policy design. It starts by highlighting the crucial difference between the engineering and economic control problem, in that the latter, unlike the former, is concerned with the control of intelligent systems. It examines the problems that this creates for macroeconomic policy formulation, and considers the usefulness of the rational expectations assumption in this context. Policy formulation is then analysed in the context of an interdependent world, and the dangers of single country policy optimisation are highlighted. It is argued that the most pressing issue is that of formulating appropriate rules, supported by penalty strategies, for the orderly conduct of macroeconomic policy in an international setting. The paper concludes by examining the conduct of United Kingdom macropolicy over the past five years, arguing that greater attention to issues of macropolicy design would have avoided some serious deficiencies in the conduct of policy.
abstract_zh: 本文综述了控制理论在宏观经济政策设计中的最新应用进展。首先，文章强调了工程控制问题与经济控制问题的关键区别：后者与前者不同，涉及对智能系统的控制。文章探讨了这种区别对宏观经济政策制定带来的问题，并评估了理性预期假设在此背景下的适用性。随后，在相互依存的世界背景下分析了政策制定，并指出了单一国家政策优化的风险。文章认为，最紧迫的问题是在国际环境中制定适当的规则，并辅以惩罚策略，以有序实施宏观经济政策。最后，文章通过考察过去五年英国宏观政策的实施情况，指出若更关注宏观政策设计问题，本可避免政策实施中的若干严重缺陷。

abstract: This paper proposes a simultaneous-equation approach to the estimation of the contribution of transport infrastructure accumulation to regional growth. We model explicitly the political-economy process driving infrastructure investments; in doing so, we eliminate a potential source of bias in production-function estimates and generate testable hypotheses on the forces that shape infrastructure policy. Our empirical findings on a panel of France's regions over 1985-91 suggest that influence activities were, indeed, significant determinants of the cross-regional allocation of transportation infrastructure investments. Moreover, we find little evidence of concern for the maximization of economic returns to infrastructure spending, even after controlling for pork-barrel and when imposing an exogenous preference for convergence in regional productivity levels.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种联立方程方法，用于估算交通基础设施积累对区域增长的贡献。我们明确构建了驱动基础设施投资的政治经济学过程模型；通过这一方法，我们消除了生产函数估计中潜在的偏误来源，并生成了关于塑造基础设施政策力量的可检验假设。基于法国各地区1985-1991年面板数据的实证结果表明，游说活动确实是交通基础设施投资跨区域分配的重要决定因素。此外，即使在控制政治分肥因素并施加外生的区域生产率趋同偏好后，我们仍发现基础设施支出经济回报最大化的考量证据不足。

title: Switching Between Existing and New Trade Agreements: Evidence From Japan's Imports From Vietnam
title_zh: 现有贸易协定与新贸易协定之间的切换：来自日本从越南进口的证据

authors: Kazunobu Hayakawa, Kenta Yamanouchi
official: 官方在线 2026-07-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We empirically investigate the utilization rates of the two existing regional trade agreements (RTAs) in Japan's monthly imports from Vietnam from January 2017 to December 2021. In particular, we explore the changes in these rates before and after the commencement of the Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans‐Pacific Partnership (CPTPP), focusing on the products for which CPTPP offered the lowest tariffs. We did not find significant changes in the utilization rates of either existing RTAs or the most‐favoured nation (MFN) regime before CPTPP's entry in January 2019. However, exporters familiar with the use of preferences (i.e., existing RTA users) appear to have switched to CPTPP first, followed by unfamiliar users (MFN users) who switched to it gradually. Consequently, the introduction of a new RTA was associated with a sustained expansion of trade, unlike the gradual tariff reduction in a single RTA observed in the previous study.
abstract_zh: 本文实证研究了2017年1月至2021年12月期间，日本从越南月度进口中两项现有区域贸易协定（RTAs）的利用率。我们特别关注《全面与进步跨太平洋伙伴关系协定》（CPTPP）生效前后这些利用率的变化，重点分析CPTPP提供最低关税的产品。研究发现，在2019年1月CPTPP生效前，现有RTAs或最惠国待遇（MFN）机制的利用率并未出现显著变化。然而，熟悉优惠使用的出口商（即现有RTA用户）似乎率先转向CPTPP，随后不熟悉优惠使用的用户（MFN用户）逐步跟进。因此，新RTAs的引入与贸易的持续扩张相关联，这与先前研究中单一RTA逐步降税所观察到的模式有所不同。

abstract: We study the role of international financial integration in buffering natural disaster shocks, using a large sample of advanced and emerging economies. Natural disasters are largely unpredictable and unrelated to the state of financial integration. We document that integration improves the absorption of such shocks: Output, consumption, and investment are significantly higher after a natural disaster in states with high than in states with low integration. The benefits are most clear for advanced economies. Emerging markets tend to profit from financial integration, too, but the estimates are less precise unless we condition on institutional quality or consider only debt assets. (JEL E21, E22, E23, F32, F33, F34, Q54)
abstract_zh: 本文利用发达经济体与新兴经济体的广泛样本，研究国际金融一体化在缓冲自然灾害冲击中的作用。自然灾害在很大程度上具有不可预测性，且与金融一体化程度无关。我们证实，金融一体化能够改善此类冲击的吸收效果：在自然灾害发生后，金融一体化程度较高的经济体，其产出、消费和投资水平显著高于一体化程度较低的经济体。这种效益在发达经济体中最为明显。新兴市场同样能从金融一体化中获益，但除非我们以制度质量作为条件或仅考虑债务资产，否则相关估计结果的精确度较低。（JEL分类号：E21, E22, E23, F32, F33, F34, Q54）

abstract: We investigate input price discrimination under secret contracting between a manufacturer and competing retailers, whose investment activities exhibit retail effort spillovers. We show that the economic effects of input price discrimination vary with the sign and magnitude of retail effort spillovers according to the contractual structure, namely, linear or two‐part tariffs. Retail effort spillovers and product differentiation affect the pass‐through of input price to retail quantity, which is defined under each contractual structure. Our analysis provides novel insights into the role of retail effort spillovers and into the evaluation of quantity pass‐through in the antitrust scrutiny of input price discrimination.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了制造商与竞争性零售商之间秘密合同下的投入品价格歧视问题，其中零售商的投资活动存在零售努力溢出效应。研究表明，投入品价格歧视的经济效应随零售努力溢出的正负及大小而变化，且这种变化取决于合同结构（线性关税或两部收费制）。零售努力溢出与产品差异化会影响投入品价格向零售数量的传导效应，该传导效应在不同合同结构下具有不同定义。本文分析为理解零售努力溢出的作用机制，以及反垄断审查中评估数量传导效应对投入品价格歧视的影响提供了全新视角。

title: Decomposition envy-freeness in random assignment

title_secondary: Decomposition envy-freeness in random assignment
authors: Yasushi Kawase, Warut Suksompong, Hanna Sumita, Yu Yokoi

abstract: In random assignment, fairness is often captured by stochastic-dominance envy-freeness (SD-EF). We observe that assignments satisfying SD-EF may admit decompositions that result in each agent envying another agent with high probability. To address this, we introduce decomposition envy-freeness (Dec-EF), which is a property of a decomposition rather than of an assignment matrix. We show that an SD-EF assignment matrix always admits a Dec-EF decomposition when there are at most three agents or the agents have at most two distinct preferences.
abstract_zh: 在随机分配中，公平性常通过随机占优无嫉妒（SD-EF）来体现。我们观察到，满足SD-EF的分配可能允许某些分解，使得每个代理以高概率嫉妒另一个代理。为解决此问题，我们引入分解无嫉妒（Dec-EF），这是关于分解而非分配矩阵的性质。我们证明，当代理数量至多为三或代理至多有两种不同偏好时，SD-EF分配矩阵总是允许一个Dec-EF分解。

title_zh: 进口总需求

authors: Chen Lian, Dmitry Mukhin, Christian Wolf
official: 官方在线 2026-06-21 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: How exposed are open economies to global demand shocks? In equilibrium, foreign booms can be absorbed either by domestic consumption ("quantities") or by real exchange rate appreciation ("prices"). We show that failures of Ricardian equivalence and global financial market imperfections, two frictions popular in much recent work, have opposite effects on the split: while elevated marginal propensities to consume push towards quantities, financial frictions instead increase price adjustment. As the flexible-price equilibrium generally features a mix of quantity and price responses, policy needs to be contractionary to achieve flexible-price outcomes if the spending effect dominates, and vice-versa if financial frictions are severe. In our quantitative explorations the spending effect tends to win the race, necessitating aggressive domestic policy action.
abstract_zh: 开放经济体对全球需求冲击的暴露程度如何？在均衡状态下，国外经济繁荣可通过国内消费（“数量”）或实际汇率升值（“价格”）两种渠道吸收。本文证明，李嘉图等价失效与全球金融市场不完善——近期研究中常见的两类摩擦——对上述分配机制具有相反影响：边际消费倾向上升会推动数量调整，而金融摩擦则强化价格调整。由于弹性价格均衡通常兼具数量与价格反应特征，当支出效应占主导时，政策需采取紧缩措施以实现弹性价格均衡；反之，若金融摩擦严重，则需采取扩张政策。在量化分析中，支出效应往往占据上风，这要求采取积极的国内政策干预。

title: Characterizing the File Drawer: Evidence from a Meta-Analysis of Parent-Interventions Around the World
title_zh: 描述文件抽屉：基于全球家长干预元分析的证据
title_primary: 描述文件抽屉：基于全球家长干预元分析的证据

authors: Peter Bergman, Nat Chowanajin
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We conduct a meta-analysis of 82 randomized controlled trials across more than 20 countries to estimate the effects of low-cost, remote parental engagement interventions delivered through text messages, phone calls, and apps. We estimate a joint likelihood function that incorporates both written studies and unwritten studies identified through trial registries, funder records, research labs, evidence clearinghouses, and other sources. By also recording sample sizes for unwritten studies, the model estimates the distribution of standard errors, identifies write-up probabilities conditional on significance, and characterizes the file drawer by estimating effect distributions for written and unwritten studies. Bias-corrected effects are 0.05 SD for test scores, 0.07 SD for grades, 0.05 SD for attendance, and 0.03 SD for enrollment. In the best-identified domain, test scores, statistically insignificant results are still written up at high rates. We also find that larger studies tend to estimate smaller latent effects, which could indicate that true effects are correlated with study precision, violating a common meta-analysis assumption. In smaller-sample domains, our approach helps identify selection probabilities by anchoring the absolute write-up rates. Finally, we estimate the value of additional RCTs to inform adoption decisions. Any single study estimate is unlikely to dissuade adoption because parent interventions have high marginal value of public funds. Instead, future research is most valuable when it can explain heterogeneity across settings.
abstract_zh: 我们对来自20多个国家的82项随机对照试验进行了元分析，以评估通过短信、电话和应用程序实施的低成本、远程家长参与干预措施的效果。我们构建了一个联合似然函数，该函数整合了已发表研究以及通过试验注册库、资助方记录、研究实验室、证据数据库及其他来源识别的未发表研究。通过同时记录未发表研究的样本量，该模型估计了标准误的分布，识别了基于显著性的撰写概率，并通过估计已发表与未发表研究的效果分布来刻画文件抽屉效应。经偏差校正后的效果为：考试成绩0.05个标准差、学业成绩0.07个标准差、出勤率0.05个标准差、入学率0.03个标准差。在识别效果最佳的考试成绩领域，统计不显著的结果仍以较高比例被撰写发表。我们还发现，样本量较大的研究倾向于估计出更小的潜在效应，这可能表明真实效应与研究精度存在相关性，从而违反了元分析中的常见假设。在样本量较小的领域，我们的方法通过锚定绝对撰写率来帮助识别选择概率。最后，我们估算了额外随机对照试验的价值，以指导采纳决策。由于家长干预措施具有较高的公共资金边际价值，任何单一研究估计值都不太可能阻止其被采纳。相反，当未来研究能够解释不同情境下的异质性时，其价值最为显著。

abstract: We document a series of stylized facts about how firms seek to protect the rents from innovation, using a large nationally representative survey of U.S. businesses over the period 2008-2015. Just 1.4 percent of firms obtain patents, but these patenting firms account for 87 percent of R&D investment. Firms consider utility patents less important than other forms of IP protection, like trade secrets, trademarks, and copyrights. Firm industry and size are strongly correlated with firms’ use of all types of intellectual property, but firm-age is not. Implications for innovation research and policy are discussed.

abstract: We assess the welfare benefits of government-funded emergency support to the financial sector, considering its effects on the probability of financial crises. In our quantitative general equilibrium model, the financial crisis probability depends on household portfolio choices and on financial intermediaries' balance sheet positions, both influenced by capital adequacy constraints (CAR) and ex-ante known emergency support provisions. The welfare-optimal CAR balances the output costs of equity financing and financial stability gains and ranges from 12.7 to 12.8 \% depending on emergency support. Comprehensive support is welfare improving under the current and optimal CAR, but likely welfare decreasing at lower ratios, or with a significant amount of shadow banking activity undermining the effectiveness of capital adequacy regulation.
abstract_zh: 我们评估了政府资助的金融部门紧急支持措施的福利收益，考虑了其对金融危机概率的影响。在我们的定量一般均衡模型中，金融危机概率取决于家庭投资组合选择及金融中介机构的资产负债表状况，这两者均受资本充足率约束（CAR）和事前已知的紧急支持条款影响。福利最优的CAR在股权融资产出成本与金融稳定收益之间取得平衡，根据紧急支持的不同，其范围在12.7%至12.8%之间。在当前及最优CAR下，全面支持能改善福利，但在较低比率下，或当影子银行活动显著削弱资本充足率监管有效性时，全面支持可能反而降低福利。

abstract: ABSTRACT Recent trade policy developments have renewed concerns about the vulnerability of agri‐food markets to tariff increases. This paper quantifies the effects of 2025 US tariff hikes and potential tit‐for‐tat retaliation on agri‐food trade, prices, output, and welfare. We employ a sectoral general‐equilibrium gravity model covering 46 agri‐food industries on a 2023 baseline. The framework combines product‐level trade elasticities with sector‐specific supply elasticities based on input‐cost shares, providing a transparent mapping from tariffs to equilibrium outcomes. We simulate the April 2, 2025 (‘Liberation Day’) tariff schedule and the July 31, 2025 revisions, each with and without symmetric retaliation by all trading partners. Without retaliation, US agri‐food exports fall by 22%–25%, output declines by about 3%, the price index rises by 6.8%–7.2%, and welfare falls by 4.4%–4.9%. With retaliation, export losses deepen to 37%–43%, output drops by 4%–5%, the price index rises by 2%–5%, and welfare declines by 6.9%–7.9%. Welfare losses are highly asymmetric: Canada and Mexico experience the largest additional losses under retaliation, reflecting integrated North American supply chains, while contractions are concentrated in processed meats, soybeans, corn, and selected food products. Retaliation amplifies global welfare losses rather than offsetting them, suggesting that cooperative policy restraint yields smaller welfare costs for the United States and its major trading partners.
abstract_zh: 摘要 近期贸易政策动态重新引发了人们对农业食品市场在关税上调面前脆弱性的担忧。本文量化了2025年美国关税上调及潜在的对等报复措施对农业食品贸易、价格、产出和福利的影响。我们采用一个涵盖46个农业食品行业、以2023年为基期的部门一般均衡引力模型。该框架将产品层面的贸易弹性与基于投入成本份额的部门特定供给弹性相结合，提供了从关税到均衡结果的透明映射。我们模拟了2025年4月2日（“解放日”）关税方案及2025年7月31日修订版，每种情况均考虑所有贸易伙伴实施对称报复与不实施报复两种情形。在无报复情况下，美国农业食品出口下降22%至25%，产出下降约3%，价格指数上升6.8%至7.2%，福利下降4.4%至4.9%。在有报复情况下，出口损失加深至37%至43%，产出下降4%至5%，价格指数上升2%至5%，福利下降6.9%至7.9%。福利损失高度不对称：加拿大和墨西哥在报复情形下承受最大的额外损失，反映了北美一体化供应链的特征，而收缩集中在加工肉类、大豆、玉米及部分食品产品上。报复措施放大了全球福利损失而非抵消之，这表明合作性的政策克制对美国及其主要贸易伙伴而言能带来更小的福利成本。

title: Politicians’ Social Welfare Criteria An Experiment With German Legislators
title_zh: 德国立法者政治家的社会福利标准实验
title_primary: 德国立法者政治家的社会福利标准实验

authors: Sandro Ambuehl, Sebastian Blesse, Philipp Doerrenberg, Christoph Feldhaus, Axel Ockenfels
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Much economic analysis derives policy recommendations based on social welfare criteria intended to model policymakers’ preferences. Yet, little is known about policymakers’ normative views suitable for this use. Our behavioural experiment elicits German legislators’ welfare criteria. When resolving preference conflicts across individuals, they place substantially more importance on least-favoured alternatives than on most-favoured alternatives, contrasting with common aggregation mechanisms and the equal weighting inherent in utilitarianism. When resolving preference conflicts within individuals, politicians choose inconsistently with behavioural economists’ most common approach to welfare analysis with time-inconsistent preferences. In distribution, politicians largely support the same welfare criteria as the public.
abstract_zh: 许多经济分析基于社会福利标准推导政策建议，旨在模拟政策制定者的偏好。然而，关于适合此用途的政策制定者规范观点，我们知之甚少。我们的行为实验揭示了德国立法者的福利标准。在解决个体间的偏好冲突时，他们赋予最不利选项的重要性远高于最有利选项，这与常见的聚合机制及功利主义中固有的平等加权形成对比。在解决个体内部的偏好冲突时，政治家的选择与行为经济学家在时间不一致偏好福利分析中最常用的方法不一致。在分配问题上，政治家与公众所支持的福利标准基本一致。

title: Does Securities Regulation Matter? Mandatory Disclosure, Excess Stock Volatility, and the US Securities Exchange Act of 1934

title_primary: 证券监管重要吗？强制披露、股票过度波动与1934年美国证券交易法

authors: Albert Bo Zhao, Sheng Li, Chenggang Xu
official: 官方在线 2026-05-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We examine whether the US Securities Exchange Act of 1934 significantly stabilized the market by introducing mandatory disclosure of information. We argue that mandatory information disclosure can curb stock manipulation by enhancing transparency, thereby reducing excess stock volatility. After a comprehensive assessment of the voluntary disclosure practices of companies listed on the New York Stock Exchange before 1934, we find that those with poor disclosure practices experienced a significantly greater reduction in volatility after the implementation of the act compared with those with good disclosure practices. Further analysis reveals that the liquidity of these companies with poor disclosure practices also improved significantly more than that of companies with better disclosure, and the improvement in liquidity was linked to the decrease in their volatility. Given that one key purpose of the act’s legislators was to reduce excess market volatility, our findings provide empirical support for considering this legislative aim successful.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了1934年美国《证券交易法》是否通过引入强制性信息披露显著稳定了市场。我们认为，强制性信息披露能够通过提升透明度抑制股票操纵行为，从而降低股票过度波动。在对1934年前纽约证券交易所上市公司自愿披露实践进行全面评估后，我们发现：相较于披露实践良好的公司，披露实践较差的公司在该法案实施后波动性下降幅度显著更大。进一步分析表明，这些披露实践较差公司的流动性改善程度也显著优于披露较好的公司，且流动性改善与其波动性下降存在关联。鉴于该法案立法者的核心目标之一是减少市场过度波动，我们的研究结果为认定该立法目标已成功实现提供了实证支持。

title: Reducing peak load from electric vehicles through grid tariffs: Evidence from a randomized field experiment
title_zh: 通过电网电价降低电动汽车峰值负荷：来自随机现场实验的证据
title_primary: 通过电网电价降低电动汽车峰值负荷：来自随机现场实验的证据

authors: Floris van Montfoort, Peter T. Dijkstra, Machiel Mulder, Dávid Kopányi
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The rapid adoption of electric vehicles (EVs) is essential for reducing CO₂ emissions, but it puts growing pressure on electricity grids by driving up peak demand. Grid tariffs can help mitigate this impact by encouraging more efficient use of grid capacity. We conduct a randomized controlled trial among more than 600 households with home EV charging to evaluate their response to a capacity-based tariff that imposes an exceedance charge on electricity consumption above a predefined capacity threshold. We test two variants: a static exceedance tariff, which charges for exceedances at all times and encourages households to reduce overall capacity use; and a Time-of-Use (TOU) exceedance tariff, which only charges for exceedances during peak hours (5 PM to 2 AM), incentivizing demand shifts to off-peak periods. We find that the static exceedance tariff reduces individual peak demand and exceedances above the threshold by approximately 5 to 10 percent, while not shifting charging to off-peak hours. In contrast, households exposed to the TOU exceedance tariff shift charging to off-peak hours after 2 AM, but without reducing individual peak demand or exceedances. Although TOU tariffs are designed to reduce peak demand, they may unintentionally create new peaks by concentrating EV charging in the same off-peak hours, revealing a clear drawback. Our findings suggest that static exceedance tariffs may be more effective in reducing peak demand.
abstract_zh: 电动汽车（EV）的快速普及对于减少二氧化碳排放至关重要，但同时也通过推高峰值需求给电网带来了日益增长的压力。电网电价可通过鼓励更高效地利用电网容量来缓解这一影响。我们针对超过600户拥有家用电动汽车充电设施的家庭开展了一项随机对照试验，以评估他们对基于容量的电价方案的反应，该方案对超过预设容量阈值的电力消耗征收超额费用。我们测试了两种变体：静态超额电价，对所有时段的超额用电收费，鼓励家庭减少整体容量使用；以及分时（TOU）超额电价，仅对高峰时段（下午5点至凌晨2点）的超额用电收费，激励需求转移至非高峰时段。我们发现，静态超额电价使个体峰值需求和超过阈值的超额用电量减少了约5%至10%，但并未将充电行为转移至非高峰时段。相比之下，接触分时超额电价的家庭将充电行为转移至凌晨2点后的非高峰时段，但并未减少个体峰值需求或超额用电量。尽管分时电价旨在降低峰值需求，却可能因将电动汽车充电集中在相同的非高峰时段而无意中制造新的峰值，这揭示了一个明显的弊端。我们的研究结果表明，静态超额电价在降低峰值需求方面可能更为有效。

abstract: We introduce a new rule-based linking method for historical Census records. We augment earlier algorithms based on name, age and place of birth (Abramitzky, Boustan, Eriksson, 2012, or “basic ABE”), with five matching characteristics – middle initial, county of residence, and spouse and parents’ names. Relative to basic ABE, ABE-Extra Information (“ABE-EI”) greatly increases match rates, improves accuracy and is similarly representative of the population on most attributes, with geographic mobility being one important exception. Relative to machine learning algorithms, ABE-EI has somewhat lower match rates, greater representativeness, and offers full replicability. We also create the first ABE-based links for women.

abstract: Modeling interference effects in high-dimensional settings presents significant challenges due to the complexity of underlying dependence structures. Existing approaches often rely on explicit and homogeneous assumptions, limiting their applicability in real-world scenarios. In this paper, we introduce a novel low-rank and sparse treatment effect model that leverages high-dimensional techniques to identify interference structures without restrictive parametric assumptions. We propose an efficient profiling algorithm for estimating model coefficients and develop statistical methodologies for both global testing of interference existence and local detection of interference-affected units. Theoretical guarantees are established, including non-asymptotic error bounds for estimation and accuracy guarantees for detection based on the Jaccard index. Through numerical experiments, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our method in high-dimensional settings, highlighting its advantages in capturing complex interference patterns.
abstract_zh: 在高维环境中建模干扰效应，因底层依赖结构的复杂性而面临重大挑战。现有方法往往依赖于明确且同质的假设，限制了其在现实场景中的适用性。本文提出了一种新颖的低秩稀疏处理效应模型，利用高维技术识别干扰结构，无需严格的参数假设。我们设计了一种高效的轮廓算法来估计模型系数，并开发了针对干扰存在性的全局检验及受干扰影响单元的局部检测的统计方法。理论保证得以确立，包括估计的非渐近误差界及基于Jaccard指数的检测准确性保证。通过数值实验，我们展示了该方法在高维环境中的有效性，并强调了其在捕捉复杂干扰模式方面的优势。

abstract: ABSTRACT Beef cattle producers have been receiving pressure to reduce methane emissions from production. Beef products with varying climate claims have recently been introduced to the retail sector, stemming from various countries‐of‐origin. Using data from a US consumer survey, we find a subset of US consumers is willing to pay a premium for Lower Carbon Footprint beef products. These consumers are willing to pay a higher premium for the claim on ribeye steak ($1.84/lb) compared to ground beef ($0.79/lb). Imported beef products with climate claims are unlikely to have major implications on the demand for US‐produced beef.

abstract: This paper estimates the racial, ethnic, and gender inequities in aggregate governmental funding to field and specialty crop farmers over 2002–2017 using a well‐matched subset of the USDA Agricultural Census microdata. I employ a coarsened exact matching model to compare most similar farmers, differentiated by Black race, Hispanic ethnicity, Asian race, and woman gender. I find that Black farmers received more funding than comparable white farmers in 2012 at both the federal and state/local levels but did not have significant differences in other years. I also find that Hispanic farmers received less federal funding in 2007 than non‐Hispanic White farmers and more state and local funding in 2012, while women have funding differences in both directions over time and in particular received more conservation funding than men. Ultimately, this paper does not find broad evidence of inequities in governmental payments for racial, ethnic, or gender minorities in the matched subset of field and specialty crop farmers. I conclude with additional ways that potential inequities could be tested by future studies.
abstract_zh: 本文利用美国农业部农业普查微观数据中匹配良好的子集，估算了2002年至2017年间政府向大田作物和特种作物种植户提供的总体资金中存在的种族、民族及性别不平等现象。我采用粗化精确匹配模型，比较了在黑人种族、西班牙裔民族、亚裔种族及女性性别方面有所不同的最相似农户。研究发现，在2012年，黑人农民在联邦及州/地方层面获得的资金均多于可比白人农民，但在其他年份无显著差异。同时，2007年西班牙裔农民获得的联邦资金少于非西班牙裔白人农民，而在2012年获得的州及地方资金更多；女性农民的资金差异随时间呈现双向变化，特别是在保护资金方面，她们获得的资金多于男性。最终，本文在匹配的大田作物和特种作物种植户子集中，并未发现政府支付在种族、民族或性别少数群体中存在广泛不平等的证据。最后，我提出了未来研究可能测试潜在不平等的其他途径。

abstract: We document that climate-triggered institutional portfolio rebalancing affects S&P 500 firms’ cost of equity through climate change price pressure (CCPP). Using a demand-based asset pricing framework, we estimate firm-level CCPP from physical and transition exposures over 2005–2021. A one-standard-deviation intensification of CCPP raises the cost of equity by up to 6% of its average, with banks and insurers as the main drivers. Yet firms do not subsequently improve environmental performance, indicating that the statistically significant effect of CCPP on cost of equity is ineffective to alter corporate behavior. Our CCPP metrics can help policymakers and investors design targeted environmental strategies.
abstract_zh: 我们记录到，气候引发的机构投资组合再平衡通过气候变化价格压力（CCPP）影响标普500公司的股权成本。利用基于需求导向的资产定价框架，我们估算了2005年至2021年间企业层面因物理和转型风险暴露而产生的CCPP。CCPP的一个标准差增强会使股权成本平均上升高达6%，其中银行和保险公司是主要驱动因素。然而，企业随后并未改善环境绩效，这表明CCPP对股权成本的统计显著效应并未有效改变企业行为。我们的CCPP指标有助于政策制定者和投资者设计针对性的环境策略。
